sources.name: Curated pub group table
sources.licence: Short factual statements, each with its public source

groups.name: Stonegate Group
groups.note: Owned by private equity firm TDR Capital; runs managed brands such as Slug & Lettuce, Be At One and Walkabout, and bought Ei Group and its leased pubs for £1.27bn in 2020.

groups.name: Star Pubs & Bars (Heineken)
groups.note: Heineken UK's pub arm, which added 1,900 pubs bought from Punch in 2017; its pubs are run by licensees who buy their beer from Heineken.

groups.name: Greene King
groups.owner: CK Asset Holdings (Hong Kong property group)
groups.note: Bury St Edmunds pub company bought by CK Asset in 2019; runs managed brands (Hungry Horse, Chef & Brewer, Farmhouse Inns, Flaming Grill, Metropolitan Pub Company) and ex-Spirit pubs such as Taylor Walker, plus tenanted pubs.

groups.name: Mitchells & Butlers
groups.note: London-listed (FTSE 250) operator of managed pubs and restaurants including Nicholson's, All Bar One, O'Neill's, Ember Inns, Vintage Inns, Browns, Toby Carvery, Harvester, Miller & Carter, Castle, Sizzling Pubs and Stonehouse.

groups.name: J D Wetherspoon
groups.owner: Listed company; founder Tim Martin is the largest shareholder
groups.note: London-listed managed pub chain including Lloyds No.1 bars; founder Tim Martin owned about 24% of the shares in 2023.

groups.name: Punch Pubs & Co
groups.note: Leases about 1,300 pubs to self-employed tenants; Fortress bought 100% of it from Patron Capital Partners.

groups.name: Admiral Taverns
groups.note: Tenanted pub company bought by US investment fund Proprium Capital Partners in 2017; bought 37 tenanted pubs from Fuller's in 2024.

groups.name: Marston's
groups.note: London-listed pub company with over 1,350 pubs; sold its 40% stake in the Carlsberg Marston's brewing business to Carlsberg in 2024.

groups.name: Young's (incl. Geronimo, Cubitt House)
groups.owner: Young & Co's Brewery PLC (AIM-listed London pub company)
groups.note: Stock-market-listed London pub company (including Geronimo and Ram Pub Company pubs) that agreed to buy the Cubitt House pubs in April 2026.

groups.name: Fuller's (Fuller, Smith & Turner)
groups.note: London-listed pub operator; sold its brewing arm to Asahi for £250m in 2019, so Fuller's beer is Asahi-owned but the pubs are not.

groups.name: Shepherd Neame
groups.note: Faversham brewer whose ownership has passed through five families; a private company whose shares are quoted on the AQSE exchange.

groups.name: Samuel Smith Old Brewery
groups.note: Tadcaster brewer with more than 20 central London pubs; its pubs only stock its own products.

groups.name: Hall & Woodhouse (Badger)
groups.note: Dorset family brewer behind Badger beers, with pubs in the south of England.

groups.name: McMullen & Sons
groups.note: Hertford brewer run on traditional family-business lines, with almost 100 pubs across Hertfordshire and London.

groups.name: Amber Taverns
groups.note: Community pub group whose 178-pub estate private equity firm Epiris took on in October 2024.

groups.name: BrewDog
groups.note: Scottish craft brewer and bar chain; trade press in 2026 names Tilray Brands as its new owner.

groups.name: Camden Town Brewery
groups.note: London brewery founded in 2010 and owned by Anheuser-Busch InBev since 2015.

groups.name: Beavertown Brewery (Heineken)
groups.note: Tottenham brewery founded in 2011 and acquired by Heineken in 2022.

groups.name: Meantime (Asahi)
groups.note: Greenwich brewery owned by Asahi Breweries since 2016.

groups.name: Urban Pubs & Bars
groups.note: Described by trade press as London's largest independent pub group, with about 65 sites; founded in 2014 by Nick Pring and Malcolm Heap.

groups.name: Remarkable Pubs
groups.note: Family business of about 17 pubs, mainly in east and north London.
